title: Use Rednote, and experience the most laughable censorship imaginable.
content:
As a 10-year user of Rednote, watching it sink deeper into its power of censorship honestly makes me sick.

Anything posted on Rednote will go through their internal “review” before it can be publicly seen. If they don’t like your content but can’t justify banning it, they just make it invisible. You can see it on your own profile but no one else can. They do the same thing with comments too. One day they approve something, the next day you get a warning saying it “violates Rednote rules.” You can repost the exact same thing and, hilariously, most of the time it gets approved again. Rednote has poured massive effort into marketing itself globally, but at its core the team just runs the app like a dictator. Making up rules on the spot and enforcing censorship so absurd that feels like a joke.

I’m honestly extremely frustrated with the customer support and appeal process.

The platform needs to provide a real and accessible customer support and appeal channel for overseas users. Right now, the process is incredibly frustrating and feels completely inaccessible.

title: Terrible Appeal Process and Customer Service
content:
Three days ago, my account was maliciously reported, and Xiaohongshu immediately suspended my ability to post or communicate for seven days. I submitted an appeal by email as instructed, but I have received absolutely no response—not even confirmation that my appeal was received.

The customer service experience has been even more frustrating. Online support told me to call phone support, while phone support told me to contact online support. Both sides claimed they had “no authority” to check the status of my appeal and simply kept telling me to wait.

Today, I called again and was first told that they were unable to look up or handle U.S.-based Xiaohongshu accounts. Then, during the same conversation, I was told that they “did not receive” my appeal email. If they cannot access or verify my U.S. account, how can they determine that my appeal was never received?

After repeatedly contacting customer service, no one can tell me whether my appeal has been received, whether it is under review, which department is responsible, or how long the process is supposed to take.

Xiaohongshu can punish an account immediately after a report, yet when a user tries to appeal that decision, there appears to be no effective or transparent way to have the case reviewed. At this rate, my seven-day suspension may be over before anyone even looks at my appeal.

A platform that has the power to restrict users’ accounts should also provide a fair, transparent, and functional appeal process. Sending users back and forth between online support, phone support, and email while repeatedly saying “please wait” is not acceptable customer service.

As a U.S.-based user, I am extremely disappointed with how this situation has been handled.

title: Do not waste your time on this garbage
content: This app is garbage; my account was banned for three months for no reason. I got banned simply because I mentioned in a group chat that I only have a Taobao account (a Chinese shopping platform) but not a Xianyu account (a Chinese second-hand marketplace)—specifically because I didn't use the 🍑 and 🐟 icons to represent the two platforms. Now, my account is blocked from sending private messages, participating in group chats, and commenting on other people's posts; it’s effectively as if my account has been forced into stealth mode. Even if you file an appeal, it’s useless; official customer service will claim your account is fine and the restrictions have been lifted, but they are actually lying. In reality, any posts, comments, private messages, or group chat messages you send are invisible to everyone else—only you can see them.

title: Do Not Use, Trample on Your Privacy.
content:
This app has absolutely no respect for users’ privacy.

1. If you grant it access to your camera or photo library, its algorithms appear to scan your entire photo collection to train its recommendation system, creating the illusion that "the app knows me so well." This is an extremely invasive way to handle users’ personal data. (Just check how many unnecessary permission requests this app has made in the background.)

2. After using the app for a while, my account was suddenly flagged as a "security risk." （The app claimed that my account was at risk because of "suspicious login activity." Seriously? I’ve been using the exact same device and the same Wi-Fi/mobile network the whole time.) To regain access, I was **forced** to take a selfie while holding my government-issued ID and upload it. There was no alternative. Customer support simply repeated the same scripted response, insisting that uploading my selfie and ID was the only option. Even more ridiculous, instead of simply requiring a password reset after detecting a suspicious login, the app demands a selfie with my ID as the "solution."

This means handing over not only your government ID, but also your biometric data. In my opinion, this is a clear case of excessive collection of personal information and a serious invasion of user privacy. This is an abuse of power by a dominant platform.

title: 为旺旺发声
content:
🇬🇧 English

I am disappointed that even in 2026, freedom of speech is still restricted on Xiaohongshu. Every animal protection and mourning post I made about the Jieyang Wang Wang animal cruelty incident was removed immediately after I posted it. What is the purpose of a social media platform if we cannot even share content for a good cause?

⸻

🇨🇳 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese)

我很失望，即使到了2026年，小红书上的言论自由依然受到限制。我发布的所有关于揭阳“旺旺”虐待动物事件的动物保护和悼念帖子，刚发出去就被删除了。如果连为了公益和善意发声的内容都不能发布，那社交媒体平台的意义又是什么？

⸻

🇹🇼 繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese)

我很失望，即使到了2026年，小紅書上的言論自由仍然受到限制。我發布的所有關於揭陽「旺旺」虐待動物事件的動物保護及悼念貼文，一發出就被刪除。如果連為了公益與善意發聲的內容都不能發布，那社群平台存在的意義是什麼？

title: Worst apps 烂透
content:
如果可以放0星 我一定放0星

真的非常愤怒！这是我用过最离谱的平台之一。😡

我注册小红书后，什么都没有做。我没有发文、没有留言、没有私讯别人，只是单纯刷视频而已，结果账号却无缘无故被封禁，而且没有任何明确原因。

账号被封后，我第一时间联系了客服。客服竟然叫我注销账号重新申请。我完全按照他们的指示操作，结果重新申请后，却又告诉我我的手机号码已经被封禁，无法继续注册。

我真的完全无法理解，到底这个平台在做什么？

我什么违规行为都没有，什么都没做，就直接封号。客服给出的解决方案不仅没有解决问题，反而让我连号码都不能用了，浪费了我大量时间。

后来，他们又要求我提交护照等个人资料进行审核。可是，这些要求在注册的时候根本没有提前说明。客服承诺审核 3 天内完成，但现在已经过去 两个多星期，账号还是没有恢复，也没有任何进度说明。

更让我无法接受的是，我看到很多创作者也是一样，影片原本都好好的，却突然被封号或限制。这种处理方式毫无透明度，也让人完全不知道平台的审核标准是什么。

我真的非常生气，也非常失望！ 一个正常使用平台、只是刷视频的用户，竟然会遭遇无故封号、客服互相推诿、审核无限期拖延，最后还要被要求提供敏感的个人资料。

这样的用户体验真的太差了。我完全无法推荐这个平台，希望官方能够正视海外用户的问题，提供合理的解释，并改善这种毫无透明度的审核和封号机制。

title: My Profile Suddenly Disappeared Overnight
content:
I’ve been using RedNote for quite some time and genuinely enjoy creating and sharing content on the platform. However, my recent experience has been extremely frustrating.

Last night, I suddenly received an adjustment notification stating that my account would be restricted and no longer visible to users in certain regions. The next day, my profile photo, display name, and bio all disappeared without any explanation.

I haven’t posted anything for weeks, nor have I done anything that I believe violates the Community Guidelines. My account is now no longer searchable, and I can’t even send private messages to my friends.

I have no idea what triggered these restrictions, and there has been no clear explanation from the platform.

Besides this issue, I’ve also experienced frequent app problems, including the app freezing, messages failing to send, and other technical issues. Now, having my account suddenly restricted without any apparent reason has made the experience even more disappointing.

I sincerely hope RedNote can investigate my case, provide a clear explanation, and improve both the platform’s stability and its account review process. It’s discouraging for genuine creators who put effort into producing quality content while following the community guidelines.

title: Truly magical
content:
I have never truly loved and enjoyed a social media platform more than Xiaohongshu.
What I found here was much more than videos and posts. I discovered the kindness of the Chinese people, endless knowledge, rich history, beautiful traditions, and genuine hearts. There is something truly magical about this platform. As someone watching from far away, I am constantly amazed and inspired by the people, culture, and stories shared every day.
The more time I spend on Xiaohongshu, the more connected I feel to the people here. What started as simply using an app became something much deeper. I met new friends who have become like family to me, and their warmth and friendship have touched my heart in ways I never expected.
In fact, I left all other social media platforms and chose to keep only Xiaohongshu. For me, it is not just an app—it has become a special place filled with memories, friendships, learning, and inspiration. It will forever hold a place in my heart.
Every day I learn something new about China—its history, culture, food, landscapes, and people. My admiration for this beautiful country grows more and more. I sincerely hope and pray that one day I can visit China, meet my dear friends in person, and experience the breathtaking scenery and rich culture with my own eyes.
Thank you to everyone who has shared their lives, knowledge, and kindness here. You may not realize it, but you have made someone on the other side of the world feel welcomed, connected, and inspired.
With love from afar. ❤️

title: Creators Beware: Account Suspended With No Reason
content:
I’ve never left negative reviews, but my experience with Xiaohongshu’s customer support has been extremely disappointing.

My account, which I primarily use to share daily life videos, was suddenly suspended without any explanation. Since then, trying to reach customer support has been a frustrating experience. Even when the chat system shows “0 people waiting,” I often have to wait more than two hours to connect with an agent. In some cases, an agent joined the chat and closed the conversation after only a few minutes because I didn’t respond immediately.

When I finally managed to speak with support, I was initially told that I would receive an update within 1–3 business days. It has now been more than three weeks with no update at all. Every time I follow up, I receive the same generic response: “The issue is being handled, please be patient.”

As a content creator, having your account unexpectedly suspended and then being left in limbo for weeks is a disaster. This is unacceptable for a platform that depends on creators. As a content creator, we spend significant time and effort making content, but when something goes wrong, there is no transparency, no real support, and no clear timeline. This platform is extremely risky and hard to trust.

title: Almost perfect, but… | 几乎完美，但是……
content:
I randomly got shadowbanned yesterday even though my account is in perfect standing (I checked) and I haven’t committed any malicious actions or breaches of the terms of service. I can still post and comment and DM, but no one can see my notes/comments/DMs. My notes don’t show up in the web browser version, only in the app.

I received an in-app system notification yesterday that my appeal was successful (but when I click on it, I get an error message); I don’t remember appealing anything and there aren’t any notes or comments of mine that have any warnings. I’m really heartbroken. I’ve made wonderful friends on 小红书 and this is the only platform I can talk to them on.

I don’t know whether or not I should contact support; I can’t afford to buy a passport, so I won’t be able to do real name verification if they ask me to. My account is linked to my Apple ID, my Weibo, my WeChat, and my Gmail. That’s as verified as I can get right now. I guess I’ll just wait a few days and see if the shadowban magically goes away.

|

content:

content:

了，我在申诉的时候我也说明了 我在这个平台还是需要完成优质创作的，也希望你们给我一个个机会，而且我保证我会改正，但是申诉了4次后还是无果，注销也注销不掉，询问官方以及后台审核都没有给出具体、明确、清晰、合理的解释，这让我不解，甚至一度怀疑后台审核到底是否公平公正。我花费大量的时间精力创造优质内容，分享个人生活，却一味的被屏蔽，被限流，没有任何具体的理由，得不到公平对待，这让我对小红书很失望。无论是自查还是官方平台都给不出任何具体的违规内容，却莫名其妙的限流屏蔽，让我真的很无奈，给不出具体的违规提示，也让我无法针对性的给出调整和修改。后台审核这种不透明不公正的审核方式严重打击了我的创作积极性以及在小红书平台的体验。我希望小红书审核闭队能重新审视审核标准和流程，提高审核的准确性和。
公正性，对于误判的内容和账号给予及时恢复，并给予用户准确清晰的反馈和指导 期待可以得到贵平台的重视和妥善处理，也希望我的账号官方可以给我早日解封，谢谢！

title: This app is better than instagram
content:
• The "Anti-Instagram" Feed: While Instagram focuses on being "perfect," Rednote thrives on being useful. Whether it’s a university assignment guide, a university site choice review, or a building construction tutorial, the content is designed to be a "Note" that teaches you something.
• Search Engine Superiority: Many users now use Rednote instead of Google for lifestyle queries. If you search for "Best cafe in KL" or "Quantity surveying study tips," you get high-quality, photo-heavy results from real people rather than SEO-optimized articles.
• AI Transparency: As of early 2026, Rednote has a strict mandate requiring all Generative AI content (images or copy) to be labeled. This has helped the platform maintain a sense of human trust that other social networks are currently losing.
• Hyper-Local Discovery: The "Nearby" tab is incredibly accurate. It’s the best tool for finding hidden gems—like a small stationery shop or a specific construction site detail—right in your immediate vicinity.

title: Avoid if you’re a creator or small business.
content:
I’ve been using Xiaohongshu for nearly 5 years, and honestly, it’s become incredibly hostile toward small personal businesses. The rules change every single day.

Recently, my friends and I noticed that hundreds—even thousands—of our posts have completely vanished from the search results. Even when I upload a new post and everything looks 'normal' on my end, it’s nowhere to be found in the latest feed. It’s like we’ve been shadowbanned for no reason.

The customer service is a joke. They are basically no different from AI—zero help. I spent days trying to reach a real human, only to get hit with the same generic templates that solve nothing. I’ve looked into this and realized so many others are in the same boat, some for over a month now. Instead of fixing their buggy system, they just blame the creators. It’s a lazy, broken system. I really hope a new app comes along to replace this soon.

title: Shadow ban and customer service bad attitude
content:
My account’s comment function appears to have been silently restricted by the system. When I post a comment, only I can see it, while other users cannot see it at all. Even worse, many of my previous comments have also disappeared for others.

This issue has been ongoing for more than a month and severely affects my ability to use the platform normally.

I have already verified the problem by testing with multiple accounts, different devices, and different networks. The result is consistent: my comments are visible only to myself but invisible to everyone else.

I contacted in-app customer support multiple times, but they repeatedly stated that they cannot escalate the issue or report it to the technical team, and simply asked me to “try posting again and observe.” This response does not address the problem at all.

If the platform has restricted my account, users deserve clear communication and transparency. Silently hiding comments without notification is extremely frustrating and undermines trust in the platform.

I strongly request that the team manually review my account and explain why my comments are being hidden. If this is a system error, it should be fixed as soon as possible.

title: Gendered Double Standards and Platform Censorship
content:
I recently came across a post that vividly illustrates the double standards surrounding how people evaluate the “value” of marriage—particularly in cases where a man marries into a woman’s family (ruzhui). In the discussion, many men emphasized the importance of maintaining their “dignity,” arguing that they would only consider ruzhui if the woman’s family were extremely wealthy or could substantially advance their careers. These material and status-based conditions functioned as concrete reference points, offering a revealing window into contemporary social norms and gendered expectations.

Notably, as the post began to attract increasing attention from female users, it was subsequently deleted, and the account that posted it was also removed. This act of censorship is striking. It not only appears excessive, but also sends an implicit message to platform users: that certain lived experiences and critical perspectives—especially those voiced by women—are considered unworthy of being seen or heard.

title: Potential Violation of App Store Privacy, Permission, and Account Enforcement Policies
content:
This app may not be compliant with platform policies regarding user privacy, permission transparency, and fair account enforcement.

During normal use of the app, without engaging in any behavior that violated the stated terms, my account was suddenly flagged as “abnormal.” No specific reason, evidence, or relevant policy reference was provided. Instead, I was required to complete real-name identity verification in order to continue using the app. This requirement appeared mandatory and coercive, with no clear appeal process or explanation of necessity, raising concerns about proportional data collection.

Additionally, the app’s permission design appears misleading. Although the system interface indicates that users can grant access to selected photos only, when attempting to change a profile picture, the app required full access to all photos on the device. The feature could not be used unless broad permissions were enabled, which undermines the principle of user choice and informed consent.

Furthermore, the app continued to display approximate location information based on IP data, including nearby address details, without explicit consent or a clear disclosure of how this location data is collected, used, or justified for core functionality.

These practices may conflict with app store requirements regarding data minimization, transparency, and non-coercive access to essential features. I recommend that this app be reviewed for compliance with applicable privacy, permissions, and user protection policies.

title: They take your data hostage
content:
Rewritten review

I am deeply alarmed by this app’s handling of accounts and personal data. I used the account for months from my home computer and iPad and built a substantial following, but suddenly the app demanded I verify my identity by sending photos of my U.S. ID—even though they already had my phone number, email, real name, and date of birth.

Contacting support was effectively impossible unless you speak Chinese. I had to find someone who speaks Chinese to help me communicate with their support team, and because of the time difference that meant contacting them at midnight. After that, they also demanded a video of me.

This sequence of requests felt extremely suspicious and invasive. I refused to hand over more sensitive personal information, and now my account is not visible and my posts—content I spent months creating—are no longer discoverable on their network. It feels like they have taken my months of work hostage and are conditioning access on handing over private data.

I do not trust this company with my sensitive information. Apple needs to investigate this app and take action to protect iPhone users from what appears to be coercive and unsafe data practices.

title: 举报和复核都跟玩一样
content:
起因是我双十一买的面膜多了，想找人拼单，后面看到别人出面膜的帖子底下很多人在问还在不在，我就去私信问对方还需不需要（现在我知道不应该私信去问了，应该就是这里的私信违规了），这件事情过了几天之后吧，突然跟我说账号违规被警告，我猜测是私信问拼单这件事被举报了，当时双十一已过，我已经不再发布这些，只是正常使用App。再过几天，说我违规禁言七天，这一次我去申诉，因为在警告之后我发布的评论寥寥无几，而且都是和帖主发布的东西相关，属于正常互动。但是被举报之后怎么申诉都没用，判定我违规。解封了十天左右，也就是今天，双十一已经一个月了，再次告诉我违规，这次禁言半个月。找人工客服就说会复核。
但是我有疑问：①为什么被举报人不能知道自己是哪里违规？问就是违规，反正违规的就是那几条，被举报了就是那几条你有问题。但是不能告诉我我到底是什么时候发布的什么内容违规的，想改都无从下手。
②私信过了两分钟无法撤回，也就是说同一件事情哪怕我以后知道不应该那样私信，过了一个月我还能因为一个月前的内容被反复举报。
③为什么同一个错误我能被反复举报，正常的应该是一次警告再禁言这样，平台规则看似是对的，实则一件事情就能达到警告再禁言七天半个月，为什么审核的时候不能看看被举报方是否已经因为这件事情被处罚过，而是不断的叠加处罚。
事已至此，禁言已经影响到我的体验，我也不想再等半个月了，谁知道半个月之后我会不会又突然在某一天告诉我被禁言一个月，现在已经严重影响到我的体验。之前每天打开手机就去小红书玩玩，碎片化的时间里小红书已经取代了抖音，但是现在我被强行戒断了，准备注销卸载了。

title: 一天乱审核
content:
小红书是一个有3亿人使用的软件，算是一个大平台吧，结果人工客服像人工智能一样乱审核、乱判账号。首先，在我使用账号的时候先一天两回弹出来实名身份认证，在经过多次实名认知之后，未显示和提醒笔记异常和违规的情况下将账号永久封禁。为此我去该平台寻找相同案例，经过一帆学习平台运营知识，了解到是笔记问题，(该笔记内容仍有合规账号在使用)但是由于手机使用无法在账号被封了的情况下删除笔记。所以我在申诉的时候提到在账号解封后会删除笔记。但是审核并未通过。至此，我找到人工客服，跟她说明情况，她先告诉我笔记状态正常，我非常怀疑笔记状态显示正常为什么账号要被封禁而不是笔记违规删除笔记?这个问题得不到答案，因此我跟人工客服再次说明了申诉的理由，她给我找到专人审核。在经过一段时间后，得到的处理结果是不通过。我不知道专人审核是真实的有在看过我的申诉和我的账号之后再做的决断，还是盲目的觉得永久封禁的账号不需要仔细辨认就一票否决??再这样的情况下，我再次寻找人工客服，她只会像机器人一样给我说我永久封禁的账号已经是专人审核后的最终结果。对此，我非常不满意，因为小红书平台搜索有大量案例证明，在了解平台运营知识，认识错误之后，找客服能得到解决方案，但是我的客服只会踢皮。最终，我意识到我应当与该平台无缘，我想要注销账号，可是提醒我注销账号仍旧会强制保留我的身份信息以及不能再注册新的账号，对此，我深深的感受到了平台侵犯了我的隐私权，我继续找客服说明我的诉求由解封账号正常使用，变成解封账号注销不再使用小红书，那个客服不能解决给我转接到了什么值班室管理，依旧是一样的话术，我并不了解客服层级关系，但是都没有给到我解决方法。
所以以我目前的心情一颗星也不想打，不知道是人工客服不负责，还是专人审核误判。

title: AI-Generated Content, Privacy Concerns, and Social Limitations
content: Xiaohongshu (RED) combines content sharing and social networking, but in practice it has several issues that make it unsuitable for genuine social interaction or friendships. Many posts are AI-generated, reducing content authenticity and making it hard for users to verify information, while popular posts may be supported by bots, increasing the risk of being misled. New accounts are often restricted almost immediately after registration, limiting posting, following, or commenting, and lifting these restrictions typically requires submitting real ID documents, raising serious privacy concerns. Social interactions are also superficial, as private messaging and comments are dominated by AI-driven or bot interactions, making it difficult to form meaningful connections. Overall, while Xiaohongshu may be appealing for lifestyle browsing and content consumption, widespread AI-generated content, immediate account restrictions, mandatory real ID verification, and shallow social interactions make it unsuitable for authentic communication and real social connections.

title: 账号被“隐形封禁”：客服复读机式回应，用户功能尽失求助无门！
content:
尊敬的小红书平台及相关监管部门：
我怀着极大的无奈和愤怒写下这个评论。我曾经是小红书平台的忠实用户，但近期的遭遇让我深感无助，仿佛陷入了一个由代码和机器人客服构成的数字迷宫，我的账号明明显示“正常”，却实际上已经“社会性死亡”。
我的账号此前因“关联账号需实名”问题被小红书系统误判，要求进行实名认证。我积极配合，通过联系客服申诉，最终解决了这个问题。账号状态显示为“正常”，我以为风波已经过去。
然而第二天发现我的账号陷入了一种“功能型瘫痪”的诡异状态：笔记零曝光： 我过去发布的所有笔记，包括曾经小有热度的内容，阅读量全部停滞为零。亲朋好友通过搜索标题、直接访问我的主页等方式，均表示看不到。新内容石沉大海： 新发布的笔记同样无人问津，没有任何自然流量，如同发布进了一个“仅自己可见”的黑洞。互动被屏蔽： 我评论他人的内容，对方完全收不到通知，也看不到我的留言。我仿佛成了一个“数字幽灵”，无法与社区进行任何有效互动。客服“死循环”： 面对如此明显的异常，我多次联系小红书客服。但每一次，我都像在对着一个设定好程序的“复读机”说话。无论我如何详细描述症状，客服的回复千篇一律：“您好，经查询，您的账号状态是正常的哦。”
这种完全无视用户具体描述、只会背诵标准答案的客服模式，不仅无法解决问题，更是对用户智商的侮辱和时间的极大浪费！
不知道为什么这么大一个平台投诉无门： 当最基本的证据——“账号状态正常”被客服用作挡箭牌时，用户的所有后续描述都会显得“苍白无力”。客服系统没有升级或转接专业技术人员的渠道，用户被永远困在第一级的“机器人客服”闭环中。请问我可以怎么找到一个负责任的、专业的回应和解决方案？

title: Unreasonable Account Suspension and Data Review on Xiaohongshu
content:
During the registration process, the platform did not indicate that users were required to submit personal information or a passport in order to use the service. However, shortly after creating the account—before I even officially started using it—my account was suddenly suspended without a clear reason.

Following the suspension, I submitted the requested documents as instructed by Xiaohongshu’s customer service team. They promised that the review would be completed within **3 days**, but it has already been more than **2 weeks**, and my account remains suspended with no resolution.

Furthermore, Xiaohongshu now requires overseas users like myself to provide **international passports** in order to proceed. This requirement was never mentioned during registration, and I strongly suspect that the platform may be using account suspension as a means to force overseas users to provide sensitive personal data. This raises serious concerns about improper collection and usage of overseas users’ private information, and it unfairly restricts our access to the platform.

title: Disappointed with Lack of Openness
content:
I find it concerning that this app does not allow users to speak up freely or share honest feedback. Comments and discussions that raise questions or highlight issues often seem to be filtered, hidden, or discouraged. This creates an environment where only one-sided voices are visible, which is not healthy for users who expect openness and real dialogue.

An app should give its community space for constructive feedback, even if it’s critical. Suppressing those voices not only reduces trust but also prevents genuine improvement. Transparency means allowing users to express concerns without fear of being silenced.

I truly hope the developers reconsider their approach and create a space where users can openly engage and be heard.

content: The app started out great, a little difficult to start up but some screen shots and google translate made that easy. I used the app for a couple days then got a message saying that I needed to verify my identity. I tried using my passport but it says it’s not supported. Also the app says I had a violation but it gives no description of what the violation is. Help center is not helpful at all, just tells me to verify my ID but then loops back around to say my passport is not supported. I’ve tried to appeal twice but it failed both times with no explanation why. I logged out and tried to log back in then it gets stuck on the birth date entry but once I put the numbers in the number pad will not minimize and will not let me hit the enter button. I’m sure there are a lot of Americans starting accounts which I’m sure is part of the issue but I’m still frustrated that there are no answers to my questions, no support, and apparently no way for me to unfreeze or start a new account. I’m sure if you are in China it’s fine but as for the US, it’s not working very well. I’m probably just going to delete the app and give up because I can’t get help with any of the problems I’m having

Don’t let the attention fade!

title: 亲爱的小红书你好有点时候真的很绝望
content:
尊敬的小红书审核组：
首先，我要明确的建议各位喜欢分享的用户 不要使用小红书平台，该平台会无故扣留用户身份信息，限制用户账号及注销的权力。
我在与网友正常聊天中于9月14日早被提示违规封号，要求实名认证，10点认证通过后解封，于当晚10点14再次封号，并以我一篇于25年发布的内容作为违规（我这边显示违规但客服查询并未违规），处置结果为“账号永久封号”而非“设备及账号封号处置”，发现账号封号时申请申诉后被小红书平台驳回，我联系客服进行二次申诉，并要求附加证据截图被客服拒绝，在无任何证据的情况下再次被告知申诉驳回，要求5天后再申诉，并且在账号冻结期间我无法解绑实名、电话井且无法注销账号，平台不得限制用户注销。线上客服以“您没有违规就不会被判罚”回复，我拨打客服电话后工作人员(没有工号)以“客服没有此类权限”没有解决并强制挂断我的客服电话。平台禁封我的第一个账号时对我的手机设备一起禁封，但未告知我“设备及账号封号处置”平台存在欺瞒用户的行为。对于该行为，属于平台无故判罚，但并未说明具体违规原因，平台的失误要求用户买单。我恳请审核组重新审视审核标准做到真正的公平公正，对于失误的判罚结果及时改正，并整改客服的业务能力，提高服务态度和质量，做到真正的绿色健康的网络平台。并对我的账号解除，谢谢！

content:

content:

title: One of the Best
content:
I joined this app in January 2025 when a lot of Americans joined. Unlike a lot of Americans, I never left. RedNote is a lot calmer, there isn’t near as much drama as some of the other apps, and more importantly, I’m finding a community of like minded people - I enjoy jade, beading, and tea, all of which I have found on RedNote. In fact, within a week or two of joining RedNote, I signed up for Mandarin lessons. And now, I’m planning a trip to China in 2026 to tour jade markets and tea gardens.

Also, I don’t want to get too political, but my eyes have truly been opened to all of the anti-China propaganda that the West likes to pander to westerners. In truth, China is a lot more like the West than Europe and the U.S. would want us to believe. They have all levels of education, economics, ideologies. China is not the boogeyman that the West would like them to be.

In closing, I love this app. I enjoy getting to see a different part of the world and make new international friends. Five out of Five Stars.

title: 请小红书审核组正视用户问题，并道歉！
content:
尊敬的小红书审核组：
首先，我要明确的建议各位喜欢分享的用户不要使用小红书平台，该平台会无故扣留用户身份信息，限制用户账号及注销的权力。

我恳请审核组重新审视审核标准做到真正的公平公正，对于失误的判罚结果及时改正，并整改客服的业务能力，提高服务态度和质量，做到真正的绿色健康的网络平台。并对我的账号解除，释放我的个人信息，对私自挂断我的咨询电话做出道歉。谢谢！

title: Poor English Translation
content:
I wanted to give Xiao Hon Shu a fair chance as it seemed like an interesting platform, but unfortunately, the overall experience was disappointing.

First, the English translation quality is extremely poor throughout the app. Many menus, buttons, and system messages are either awkwardly translated or left entirely in Chinese, making navigation difficult for non-Chinese speakers. It gives the impression that the app is not fully localized and that English users were an afterthought in the development process.

Additionally, a significant number of options and features remain untranslated, which affects the usability of the app. It’s frustrating to encounter important settings or recommended content tabs that are still presented in Chinese with no clear way to switch languages.

Another major issue I faced was with the content recommendations. Most of the content suggested to me was either completely irrelevant to my interests or heavily skewed towards sexually suggestive material, even though I had not indicated any preference for such content. This made the experience feel not only unprofessional but also uncomfortable.

Overall, the app feels poorly curated and lacks proper language support. I would not recommend it to English-speaking users unless these issues are addressed. Better translation, proper localization, and improved content moderation are urgently needed.

title: Social media that doesn’t rot your brain (unless you are into that)
content:
A lovely and intuitive app,
Its like what social media was meant to be before it all became a nightmare of adds and toxicity.
The community is wonderful. Very friendly! There is a great sense of humor with good natured teasing, useful insight, and a genuine willingness to connect and learn. There are creators and netizens from around the world coming together sharing their art, culture, passions, and generally giving glimpses into what their life is like.

It’s not the place to be a troll or needlessly stir up bad faith drama. The report button actually works, with feedback/follow-up letting you know how the issues resolved.

The algorithm is very responsive to your actual interests, and you have the option to review the topics it is feeding you.

The current translation feature(from the English speaking side) is currently only English-Chinese, and seems to work very well with only a few mishaps here and there which is to be expected.
I do hope they expand this to more languages in the future, but for now, I’m enjoying the opportunity to work on my Spanish

They recently opened the store to foreigners. In theory, this would be a great opportunity to have more direct access to goods that don’t have a middle man cutting quality for profits, and get honest reviews from everyday people, but with the economy being on fire…

Anyways it’s a great app, if you are tired of being fed inflammatory slop, on platforms filled with trolls, give this a try!

title: My favorite social media app
content:
While initially suited for Chinese audiences, Rednote has been a welcoming place for those in other parts of the world. While some features like the store haven’t been converted yet to allow for western audiences, Rednote has gone above and beyond in adapting to the influx of foreign users.

I joined Rednote after TikTok was banned the first time and within a week, they offered translation services for comments and posts into English. I will say however, it only translates Mandarin to English but not other languages to English. Rednote is adamant in enforcing a safe, healthy environment with rules and regulations that frown upon unsavory and incendiary actions such as hate speech and flaunting wealth.

Their posts have a function that lets you directly train the algorithm to put in the content that you enjoy, and completely remove what you don’t. I will say, though, that reporting behavior is a bit challenging, since much of those pages are still in mandarin without English options, as far as I know. As of April 2025.

All of this being said, I give Rednote a full 5 stars due to the receptiveness to feedback from their members and their quick action in making the app more user friendly for non mandarin speaking audiences.

content: Since joining I have been able to destress. When I came from TikTok I was completely overwhelmed and fearful. With all the chaos that Trump is causing I’m sure I’m going to die. They learned English so they could speak with us, the APP developers even made translation available for us. They showed us their rich beautiful culture, their unique meme’s and invited us in without prejudice. Thanks to the videos and people I stopped feeling anxiety, first they helped me calm down with funny videos. I felt a sense of relief seeing that it wasn’t as hopeless and TikTok MAGA was showing, there are still good people around. I deleted my TikTok and never looked back. I don’t post videos on here yet as I’m still learning but I’m not going to leave. There are so many wonderful people and friends I’ve been making and hope to keep making.

title: Completely different from what I know
content: For years as an American, I have been riddled with ads on ads on ads, thinking that this was the normal for society, thinking this was the normal worldwide when apparently it is not the normal. I’m not being sold to or assaulted by ads constantly during the day, if I don’t like something, I can just swipe past it and not have to have the algorithm push more and more of it into my face. Their algorithm is different from the platform I came from but in a way it is very much better. Learning that this is more of a shared experience platform rather than entertainment was definitely jarring not knowing what I’d be able to learn. But I will tell you I have learned so much on top of being entertained. There’s so many cultures that have migrated to this app. I can’t even begin to explain what level of cultural exchange that it has brought to the world probably the best thing we’ve ever had in history. I truly hope it stays this way.

title: A safe place for Americans and other “refugees”
content: I downloaded this app when a popular American app, that I’m sure doesn’t need to be named, went dark. I deleted the other app knowing that I would not be going back to it after seeing the disclaimer of hope from the orange “savior.” Rednote has not only kept me sane in these trying times we’re experiencing here, it has also kept me informed, connected to familiar American/english speaking content creators that migrated to the app, as well as many new creators from all around the world. This app is a friendlier, more informative, and all around better place to be in the age of social media. The creators have added many translation features to help the migration go smoothly and to allow the app to be used inclusively from any country, language, or culture.

title: The dev team is as wonderful as the community
content: Like most of us, I arrived on RedNote after The Ungreat TikTok Ban. I expected to be perpetually a guest and to have to figure out my own way around. Instead, the dev team worked overtime: they created English/Mandarin translation software within days, spotted the "cat tax" trend and created a button where Americans could post our pets with fewer language barriers so we could more easily begin to integrate with the existing community, and basically were welcoming and tireless even in the face of a sudden unexpected influx of foreigners. Many people have spoken about the beauty of the community, and this is true, but as someone with friends in IT I recognize just how large an undertaking this was and would be completely unsurprised to hear the devs had some extremely long work hours that week. Please know I truly appreciate the sacrifices you made to welcome us so warmly to your village!

title: Xiaohongshu - Little Red Book
content:
**Review of Red Note (Little Red Book)**

As an American from 美国, I’m learning, **Red Note (Little Red Book)** has been a great way to explore Chinese 中国人 culture and discover new products. The app combines social media and e-commerce, offering authentic reviews, recommendations, and even hilarious comedy skits! (My favorite)

**What I Love and Enjoy**
**Cultural Insight**
A window into Chinese beauty, fashion, and lifestyle trends.

**Authentic Content**
Genuine user reviews make it easy to discover new products.

**Comedy Skits**
The funny and relatable skits add a unique, entertaining touch.

**Welcoming Community**
Many users post in English, making it inclusive for international users.

**Areas for Improvement**

**Language Barrier**
Better translation features would help.

**Interactive Features**
Adding polls, quizzes, or challenges (e.g., "Try this trend and share your results!") could make the app more engaging and interactive.

**Overall**
Red Note is a fantastic app for learning about Chinese culture, finding reliable recommendations, and enjoying a good laugh or two. I wholeheartedly recommend this app!

author: Dub Dub Boi

title: Xiaohongshu isn’t just an app.
content:
It’s a gateway to genuine connections. Social platforms can often feel overwhelming or impersonal, Red Note stands out as a place where you can truly meet people from all over the world and feel at ease doing so.

What I love most is the welcoming, positive environment. It’s rare to find a platform where conversations flow naturally, friendships form authentically, and you’re reminded of how small, yet beautiful, the world can be. I’ve connected with people from places I never thought I would, and it’s not just about casual chatting, it’s about sharing experiences, cultures, and stories that leave a lasting impact.

The platform itself is easy to use, but what makes it special is the experience it provides. Red Note is proof that technology, when done right, can bring people closer in the most meaningful ways. If you’re looking for a place to connect without the noise, this is it.

title: Cool app! Trying to figure out how to use the shopping features
content:
Really enjoy using this app! I appreciate how supportive and kind the developers are towards English-speaking users despite them not being the main user market. Additionally, and I totally understand this is unlikely and once again only respectfully suggest it, I would love if I could pay with PayPal since I’ve seen some wonderful art I want to purchase but I buy everything online via PayPal and I don’t have any other payment app accounts to pay with. Completely understand that PayPal isn’t as common in China though and that it would be a feature primarily for international users. Just wanted to put it out there as a suggestion but understand if it cannot be implemented!

Very nice app with a friendly community 👍 Will continue to use it

author: Pooweedoodoo

title: bad personalize system
content: rednote strength lies in its authentic user feedback - a rare commodity in today's internet landscape - allowing you to find a wealth of valuable information. However, their recommendation system, designed to maximize user addiction, ruins everything. The algorithm is a complete disaster, especially when you turn off the system recommendations and personalization features. To make matters worse, there's no way to block other users - once you disable those settings, you're completely stuck with no control over unwanted interactions. After turning off recommendations, many basic functions become unusable, and the app subtly - sometimes forcefully - manipulates you into re-enabling the recommendation system through seemingly unrelated options. An app with such a predatory approach to user manipulation deserves no more than 1 star."

author: Maria DeJong

title: This App is an eye opener for Americans!
content:
The Chinese people are so kind and friendly, so willing to share their culture with us, that the whole TikTok debacle ended up being a blessing! The exchange of ideas, history and culture between Americans and Chinese on Red Note is, I believe, an important and historical event. Some of the "Welcome, TikTok Refugees" posts brought me to tears. My only complaint is that I cannot find a way to translate within the app. I can't read the buttons, so I don't know what to click! I have had to copy and paste everything to Google Translate. I was able to translate the rules and regulations, because there was a "translate" button that popped up when I highlighted sections of the content. But on the "Creator Center", I could not highlight anything to get that translator button up. I am hoping the creators will see the need for easier translation capabilities once they realize thousands of Americans have gone to their app from TikTok. Being able to communicate with the Chinese people is so exciting to me that even if TikTok returns, I will keep my Red Note account for as long as the Chinese let me! I highly recommend!

title: Thank you, RedNote developers- sincerely, an American
content:
I just want to say this first- thank you to the owners and developers of this app for being so accommodating to the American users that migrated from TikTok to your app. You really didn’t have to be, but you were anyways.

The translation button, making it so you could read the IP addresses in English if that was your language setting, the continued updates. It’s been so nice to have an app team respond so quickly to user suggestion.

Secondly- I want to thank all my foreign friends who have not only shared their life and culture, and have encouraged us to share ours as well. The kindness on this app is unmatched, and unlike anything I’ve ever seen online. This truly is an incredible app, and it’s a privilege to scroll with you all and learn from each other.

I would however like to make a suggestion. The English to Chinese translation feature is wonderful, but I do think there is room for expansion. There are many Americans/non Chinese users who don’t speak either English or Chinese, so adding translation for possibly Spanish, Russian, and other popular languages might be helpful?

I understand this is a big task, and I know the developers worked tirelessly to make the original translation EN-CH feature possible; which I again thank you for tremendously. This is my only suggestion, if it has not happened already (I just came and updated the app as of writing this review). Thank you again, to all of you. Much love from the U.S.♥️♥️

author: Zuckerberg scam

title: A Beautiful App for Connection, Learning, and Cultural Exchange
content:
I absolutely love Xiaohongshu / Little Red Book! The posts from Chinese users are not only funny and silly but also filled with warmth and kindness. The community is so welcoming and inclusive, creating an environment that feels like home.

I joined the app before the TikTok ban, and while some hoped we’d all return to Facebook and Instagram, when the ban came into affect, that’s not the case for me. Xiaohongshu / Little Red Book has been a turning point in my life. It’s amazing to see China’s breathtaking beauty—from the bright lights of the cities to the serene countryside. As someone who lives paycheck to paycheck, it’s incredible to experience a place I’ll likely never visit and connect with the people there.

The app has also been a window into both the United States and China, showing the lives of ordinary people in both places. I feel like we’re witnessing history in the making. Despite the hatred that exists in the world, Xiaohongshu / Little Red Book shows that we are all humans who want peace, love and acceptance with curiosity of others in the world around us.

Even if TikTok returns, I’ll continue to use Xiaohongshu. It’s been a source of joy, learning, and connection. From discovering new recipes to understanding Chinese culture, I’ve learned so much and made new friends along the way. I truly hope our government doesn’t take this app away from us. It’s an amazing platform, and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to broaden their horizons and experience something truly special.

title: The moment Americans see the real world
content:
The sudden popularity of this app (RedNote) in the U.S. has sparked an unexpected cultural exchange between Chinese and American users. Many Americans see this as a rare chance to step outside the carefully curated bubble of U.S. capitals and media-controlled platforms and experience a more unfiltered, diverse world. For some, this is the first time they feel like they’re seeing a global perspective untouched by the influence of American algorithms or corporate agendas.

Traditionally, the U.S. is portrayed as a beacon of diversity, but critics argue that American social media platforms often promote a sanitized, homogeneous version of the world. Algorithms are designed to maximize engagement, often feeding users what they want to see—or what corporations and governments want them to see—rather than offering a truly diverse flow of information. This has led to an increasingly narrow perception of the world for many Americans.

In contrast, RedNote's content feels fresh and authentic, offering glimpses into real lives and cultures outside of the typical Western narrative. For many users, this is a wake-up call, exposing them to perspectives and stories they’ve never encountered. It’s ironic that, in seeking freedom from perceived U.S. media manipulation, many have turned to a Chinese platform to rediscover what diversity and authenticity truly mean.

title: This is better than any social media app I’ve ever tried
content:
I’m studying UX in college and I have to say that this app really impressed me.

This feels like a company that actually gives priority to its UX/UI designers. The architecture, layout, content and visual design is GREAT. There is no bombardment of hidden ads. You, as a user, have a great flexibility when it comes to what you’d like to post and where. The filters for videos are high quality, as are the text options which are very diverse unlike Instagram or TikTok.

Despite being a Chinese app, elements are designed in such a way that you can easily navigate the app even without understanding the actual words. What is more, this app is like a perfect blend between Pinterest, tiktok, and reddit, with additional features added on.

My only recommendation is to have a more easily navigable way to save sounds for your own use later on. Most users would like to use them later rather than immediately so it would be nicer if clicking on a sound wouldn’t immediately take you to the recording page.

Otherwise.. Props to the UX/UI designers of this company!

title: 小红书适合发笔记但不适合读笔记
content:
网友都把小红书叫做生活版百度百科，我深以为然，上面的很多信息具备其他平台没有的真实性，技巧也是简单易得的，这应该是很多用户的核心需求，而实现这个需求的载体就是笔记。
在发笔记方面虽然功能也不见得多完善，但是因为对标的是ins，这些功能也够用了。但是对于读笔记的人来说，只有点赞收藏评论，和抖音之类的短视频一样的功能设计。可是短视频要的就是在几秒之内强烈的视听觉冲击，不需要过多停留点个赞就刷下一个。小红书作为一个以图文为核心的app，读文字起码要花费几分钟，而且文字内容也和微博平台多见的观点不同，一般是实用性步骤，就更需要一些功能方便用户重点标记或者截存文段中所需要的部分。
总结一下就是希望小红书出一些便利读笔记的用户的功能。这样虽然笔记的“翻台率”下降了，但是用户的app使用时间和依赖性应该是上升的。

在发笔记方面虽然功能也不见得多完善，但是因为对标的是ins，这些功能也够用了。但是对于读笔记的人来说，只有点赞收藏评论，和抖音之类的短视频一样的功能设计。可是短视频要的就是在几秒之内强烈的视听觉冲击，不需要过多停留点个赞就刷下一个。小红书作为一个以图文为核心的app，读文字起码要花费几分钟，而且文字内容也和微博平台多见的观点不同，一般是实用性步骤，就更需要一些功能方便用户重点标记或者截存文段中所需要的部分。
总结一下就是希望小红书出一些便利读笔记的用户的功能。这样虽然笔记的“翻台率”下降了，但是用户的app使用时间和依赖性应该是上升的。

title: 入坑两周的几句实话
content:
平台内博主用词，说话都比较绝对和极端，可能也是为了博眼球，很多文章几乎没有客观性，真实性也存疑，容易误导人。

平台问题：
1. 登录有效期太短，一天得登录4.5次，带着环境参数申诉过，机器人🤖️回复； 2. 没有在线客服，可能是为了省成本，只能异步申诉问题，不做评价； 3. UI 瑕疵太多，随便好几个，例如输入键盘会cover掉input area，几乎在盲打。字数上限计算不是按实际计算，而是读键盘内容，导致95/100时打不出“爽 shuang ”这种6音节的字；内容可视区域和键盘UI分布有问题，滑动动作监听太弱导致唤起键盘…… 4. 内容比较流量导向，不过这也是各种内容平台的通病，离职媛大型晒工牌平台。 5. 背景音乐选择可以增加个搜索选项吗？ 6. 作为一个类手帐的app还不错，就是购物引流比较厉害

title: Best option for China but still a horrible app
content:
Pros: None. It’s at best a normal social media app.
Cons: (1) The app will edit your own bio without your permission and then prohibit you from editing it; (2) The English version has lots of spelling errors in the UI; (3) Bad UI • Stops your music when you start preparing a post even of just pictures, not video; (4) Every time you comment or send a message the app gives you a prompt to turn on notifications even if you don’t want to, and you can’t disable it; (5) Recommended content is generic and influencers’ content is heavily edited/artificial; (6) LOTS of pirated/fake/stolen content, and lots of fake accounts; (7) You can’t say anything even slightly controversial. I tried to report a Chinese person pretending to be an American soldier at the embassy in Beijing and I couldn’t because my report and post warning others about the fake account were “sensitive” and related to foreign news.
